idea-plugin.name: GitHub Copilot Premium Quota Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
GitHub Copilot Premium Quota Monitor is an IntelliJ Platform plugin that displays your remaining GitHub Copilot Premium quota directly in the IDE status bar.
Main features: - Status bar widget showing the remaining premium quota as a percentage, with color-coded urgency. - Tooltip with detailed quota information, including remaining requests and renewal date. - Manual and automatic background refresh of quota data. - Quick actions via widget popup: Refresh, Sign in, Sign out. - OAuth Device Flow authentication for secure GitHub sign-in, with tokens stored in PasswordSafe. - Visual states for loading, unlimited plans, unauthenticated and error conditions. - Full support for JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, etc.). - Localization support (English and Italian included).
A GitHub account with an active Copilot subscription is required to retrieve quota information. The plugin is independent from the official GitHub Copilot plugin and works with all compatible JetBrains IDEs.
